_note: Single source of truth for buildings, resources and base layout. Read by the server (validation, economy) and by Hadal > Setup in Unity (ScriptableObjects). Rules and the balance table: docs/23_Base_Management.md. Rates are per simulation tick (SimulationTick.IntervalSeconds) at level 1. buildCost/buildSeconds are for level 1; higher levels scale by progression.costGrowth/timeGrowth. requiredReactorLevel gates a building, maxCount caps how many a base may own.
